countdowntimer.usage: Usage: (timer name datetime [interval minutes, 1-1440; default 10] | message). Quote datetime strings containing spaces. Escape message tag parentheses as \( and \).
countdowntimer.stopusage: Usage: (stoptimer name). Names may contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
countdowntimer.permission: Moderator permission is required to start or stop countdown timers.
countdowntimer.invalid: The timer deadline must be a valid future datetime. Include a UTC offset, or use (nexttime HH:MM) for the next local time.
